description: Artifact storage abstraction (IArtifactStore) for OctoMesh services with file system, S3 and Azure Blob providers

Azure Cosmos DB (SQL API) adapter for Vali-Flow.NoSql — translates the provider-agnostic IR tree into a parameterized Cosmos SQL WHERE clause fragment. Use .ToCosmosDb() on any ValiFlow<T> or Expression<Func<T, bool>>.

Couchbase adapter for Vali-Flow.NoSql — translates the provider-agnostic IR tree into a parameterized N1QL (SQL++) WHERE clause fragment. Use .ToCouchbase() on any ValiFlow<T> or Expression<Func<T, bool>>.

Google Cloud Firestore adapter for Vali-Flow.NoSql — translates the provider-agnostic IR tree into a native Google.Cloud.Firestore.Filter. Use .ToFirestore() on any ValiFlow<T> or Expression<Func<T, bool>>.
